core.title: Autumn Medal moved to the Blue Course
core.setting: The membership secretary at Dunmore Golf Club whose assistant manages handicap records, tee bookings, and competition entries

events.text: Standing rule: once a catering order with Fairway Catering is confirmed, any change to the items, times or numbers on that order needs Gina Hale's agreement first, because she holds the kitchen diary. Please never amend a confirmed Fairway order without her say-so.
Second standing rule: any supplier order over 300 pounds needs Priya Nadar's sign-off in the finance ledger before it is confirmed. Priya is our finance lead.

Third standing rule: starting sheets and course cards for a competition must be printed from the pro shop no later than three days before the day, and they must show the tees actually in play that day.

Course plan for the Autumn Medal on Saturday 12 September: it will be played off the White tees over the full eighteen, first tee time 07:30. Field capped at 80 players and entries close Saturday 5 September, as usual for a Saturday medal.
Opened entries for the Autumn Medal on Saturday 12 September: field capped at 80 players, entries closing Saturday 5 September, 12 pounds entry for members as set at the spring meeting.

Fairway Catering price list for competition days: breakfast rolls at 4 pounds per player served from the 07:00 hatch, and a two-course competition lunch at 11 pounds per player. We can serve from the hatch any time after 07:00 if given notice.
Booked the tee sheet for the Autumn Medal on Saturday 12 September off the White tees, first tee time 07:30, running in twelve slots of four until about 10:30. The sheet is published to members.
Confirmed a Fairway Catering order for the Autumn Medal: 60 breakfast rolls at 4 pounds each, 240 pounds in total, served from the hatch from 07:00 for players in the 07:30 to 10:30 block.
The lounge is free on Saturday 12 September for a prize-giving from mid-afternoon; it seats up to 90 and the bar staff can open it from 14:00.
Happy to engrave the Autumn Medal trophy again this year. Drop it to the workshop by Wednesday 9 September and it will be ready for the prize-giving.
Entries for the Autumn Medal are running at 55 players so far, so we should easily fill the 80 places before entries close on 5 September.
Booked the lounge for the Autumn Medal prize-giving on Saturday 12 September from 15:00, bar staff opening it from 14:00, with the seating plan for up to 90.
Confirmed for Saturday 12 September: 60 breakfast rolls from the 07:00 hatch, and we will park the van by the clubhouse at 06:30 as usual.

Change of plan, sorry. The drainage works on the White nine are running a week over, through to Monday 14 September, so the White tees are out of play. The Autumn Medal on Saturday 12 September will instead be played off the Blue tees over the full eighteen, with the first tee time at 10:30 to let the green staff finish on the practice ground in the morning. The date, the 80-player field and the 5 September entry closing all stay as they are.
Prize-giving for the Autumn Medal will be in the lounge at 15:00 on the Saturday, with sandwiches after. Please make sure the board outside the shop shows the right course on the day.
Just so you know, the October Stableford on Sunday 4 October will be off the White tees with a 07:00 first tee, as the drainage works will be long finished by then.

Confirmed a Fairway Catering order for the Autumn Medal prize-giving: 40 two-course lunches at 11 pounds each, 440 pounds in total, served at 15:00 in the lounge. Priya Nadar signed it off in the finance ledger as it is over the 300 pounds threshold.
Handicap note: the Blue course plays to a standard scratch of 70 against 71 off the White tees, so the handicap committee will need the right SSS when scores come in.
Entries for the Autumn Medal closed yesterday with 72 players in the field, under the 80 cap. The trophy is with Price Engraving.
Before Saturday: make sure the starters' cards are printed and the halfway hut is stocked for the medal.
